detail.longDescription: I imagine everyone here has received an unsolicited message telling them that their tax is overdue and that they urgently need to visit Genuine-Tax-Payment-Website.fart or that a parcel is delayed at customs and you can pay a small sum for its release at Almost-The-Right-Acronym.ak  You know it is a scam. Most people just mark as spam and move on with their day. But a significant number of people …
